notablePrerequisites:
Empowered Autogenerator has at least three charge counters on it.
"Mirran" chosen with Mirrodin Besieged.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator's first ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {4}.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Mirrodin Besieged triggers, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, triggering itself.
Holding priority, activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Myr and Ancestral Statue, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
